The claim accurately reflects the formula and definition provided in Source [S1], Section 3.2. The source explicitly states: 'We calculate the spatial error of node T as the sum of the MSE between the data at node T and the data of the same time step at T’s eight spatial child nodes in the next spatial level of the octree... adding the maximum spatial error of the child nodes. Written in formula: se(T) = sum(MSE(T, Ti)) + MAX{se(Ti)}'.
